decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core offer needs little extra resource, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search one year after launch.
This handle family fits the established system breadth, and a large firm's slack lets it carry the line while early results are still uncertain.
A single new handle design close to the core business is cheap to keep in the portfolio and is too new to judge against aspiration levels.
This design product sits within the established range, and with no evidence of underperformance management would retain it.
A multi-model handle family supports the firm's breadth across budget levels and shows no shortfall that would call for reallocating resources.
The L700 electronic access system is the flagship of the firm's digital building organisation strategy, so management will protect it with slack despite uncertain early results.
